verdict.rationale: Community Phone runs porting as a hand-held process. A dedicated rep keeps the customer updated throughout, and the vendor gives a generic timeframe of about 3-5 business days. There is no documented status view in the app or dashboard, no per-port expected completion date, and no documented reason given when a port is rejected. missing for 10: in-product port status tracking, a specific expected completion date per port, rejection reasons for failed ports, independent corroboration

support.subject: As a founder, a port shows its status and expected completion date, and a rejected port says why

citations.quote: your dedicated rep stays in touch with you through the entire process, keeping you updated, and helping you through challenges.
Community Phone will port your number in 3-5 business days without disrupting your service.
Number transfer (porting) from any carrier is free and takes about 5 business days.
you will be assigned a dedicated representative from Community Phone who will be your contact throughout the process.
